hooks.name: Privacy guard: counts only
hooks.description: Optional. After the agent saves a file in src/, warn if any personal TDLR column name appears in src/. Off by default; set enabled to true to use it.

action.command: if grep -rnE 'owner_name|owner_telephone|mailing_address|business_address|business_telephone|business_name|license_number|license_expiration' src; then echo 'Privacy guard: a personal TDLR field name appears in src/. Counts only: license_type, business_county, count(*).' >&2; exit 1; fi
